sceneManager: Scene manager — model list, visibility, transform
overlayOn: Hide validation highlights in the 3D scene
overlayOff: Show validation issues highlighted in the 3D scene
idsTooltip: Check the model against a buildingSMART IDS file
compareTooltip: Compare versions of your IFC set: changes, IDS and BCF
mapTooltip: Show the model on a real-world map (georeferenced)
sunTooltip: Sun & Moon study — real shadows by date, time and location
embedTooltip: Get an embeddable iframe / link for this model
legendTooltip: Color legend — entity types in this model

embedModal.title: Embed this viewer
embedModal.intro: Generate a link or <iframe> to drop this interactive 3D IFC viewer into a blog post, article, or CDE panel.
embedModal.modelUrlHelp: The file must be reachable over HTTPS and allow cross-origin (CORS) requests.

preset.articleDesc: Figure for a post: canvas, tight framing, page scroll
preset.embedDesc: Inside a host app: 3D + properties, Validate & Measure, no Open/Share/account

embedModal.noUrl: Enter a public IFC URL above to generate the embed code.
embedModal.corsNote: The model is fetched in the visitor's browser — it never touches our servers. The host must send CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin) for the file to load.
embedModal.whereHint: Paste into a blog, a CDE panel, Notion, a Power BI “Web content” visual or any dashboard.
embedModal.sunOn: Open the sun study on load
embedModal.sunEvergreen: Leave the year out and the link stays evergreen — the same day, every year.
embedModal.siteNote: Needs a georeferenced model. Streams map and terrain tiles from third parties, and OpenStreetMap data must stay attributed — enabling this makes that call for your page’s visitors.

exportModal.title: Export
exportModal.ifcNotAvailable: IFC buffer not available (model loaded from fragments cache only)
exportModal.advancedHint: What the exported file says about itself. IFC records this in its STEP header, and it is what a recipient reads to tell your file apart from what the authoring tool shipped.
exportModal.stampHeader: Record this export in the file
exportModal.stampOn: Sets the write date to now and the writing tool to {{app}}. The authoring application is left as it was — the model still came from there.
exportModal.stampOff: The header will keep the original tool and date, so the file will look untouched even if you edited it.
exportModal.author: Author
exportModal.blankKeeps: Leave a field blank to keep whatever the file already carried.
exportModal.schemaNote: The IFC schema is never changed. A file opened as IFC2x3 is exported as IFC2x3.

menu.openTooltip: Open — IFC files, demo models and scene files
menu.checkTooltip: Check — issues in 3D, IDS, compare versions
menu.addDataTooltip: Add data — scans, video, 3D models, map layers and live devices

addData.title: Add data to the scene
addData.description: Files are read in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
addData.dropHint: Mix any of these formats — each file goes where it belongs.
addData.fromUpload: Scans, video, 3D models or map layers?

pointcloud.title: Point cloud
pointcloud.desc: Laser scans and drone photogrammetry. They land on your model when the file says where they are.

video.title: 3D video
video.desc: Site or drone footage on a screen, on the ground, or matched to the camera that filmed it.

ifc.title: IFC model
ifc.desc: Discipline models federate into one scene. Each is reviewed before it loads; the first sets the coordinates.

mesh.title: 3D model
mesh.desc: Props and context models in glTF or OBJ, placed on your model's floor.

map.title: Map & terrain
map.desc: Basemap, 3D terrain and the buildings around a georeferenced model.

layers.title: Data layers
layers.desc: Points, routes and zones from GeoJSON or CSV files, URLs, WFS services or public live feeds.

devices.title: Live devices
devices.desc: Sensors over REST, WebSocket or MQTT, bound to IFC elements.

scene.title: Scene file
scene.desc: A .scene.json someone shared with you. Opening it replaces the current scene.

addData.pointcloudNote: E57, ReCap or FARO? Export as LAS, LAZ or PLY first.
addData.needsModel: Needs an IFC model in the scene first
addData.chooseFolderHint: A whole project folder: IFCs, scans, GeoJSON, meshes and zips are sorted automatically

drop.title: Drop to add to the scene
drop.legend: Each file goes where it belongs:
drop.afterReview: {{names}} will be added after the IFC review
drop.sceneAlone: A scene file opens on its own. Add the other files once it has loaded.
drop.archiveUnsupported: {{names}}: RAR and 7z cannot be opened in the browser yet — save it as .zip, or drop the folder itself
drop.archiveTruncated: The archive is very large: only the first part was taken (4 GB / 5,000 files)
